category_title: Elementary student with ASD engaging in head-banging and arm-biting during transitions
student_description: Jake is an elementary student with ASD and an intellectual impairment who engages in severe, automatically reinforced self-injurious behavior (head-banging, arm-biting) when unoccupied or transitioning. Because his behavior is sensory-seeking rather than socially mediated, he uniquely requires continuous access to competing sensory input and cannot simply be ignored or left alone.

criteria.rationale: Jake requires a consistent, proactive approach across all environments (specials, transitions, independent work) to manage his automatically reinforced SIB.
criteria.check: The long-term plan systematically embeds continuous access to sensory items (NCR) and reinforcement for alternative behaviors (DRO) across various daily routines.

criteria.rationale: Tracking SIB frequency is essential to verify that the sensory and reinforcement interventions are effectively reducing his self-injury over time.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes a specific mechanism for tracking and monitoring the frequency or severity of Jake's self-injurious behaviors.
